idle_motion_notes: No secondary idle motion is visible (no breathing chest movement, no blanket settling, no hair/fabric sway) across consecutive same-setup frames -- the bedding, pillows, and background props (tissue box, clock, pendant lamp) are pixel-identical between periodic-0/2/3 and between scene-0/scene-1, indicating the environment and idle character parts are fully static holds while only the acting character's face/hand updates.
frame_rate_feel: Video is encoded at 30fps per metadata, but the animation reads as posed on much longer holds -- multiple periodic frames only ~0.3-0.4s apart show zero change in body pose, background, or even eye position, implying the puppet performance itself is being updated far below 30fps (consistent with on-2s or on-3s stop-motion holds) while the 30fps stream simply re-displays the same held frame repeatedly.
overall_animation_style_notes: Minimalist, deadpan stop-motion-style animation: one character (or one body part) is animated per beat while everyone/everything else in frame is frozen, producing a deliberately stiff, sitcom-timing feel that matches the flat, complaint/comeback dialogue rhythm. The visual comedy relies on held, unblinking, wide-eyed 'blank stare' faces punctuated by brief, isolated mouth or hand movement rather than full-body or continuous facial animation -- the stillness itself reads as part of the joke's deadpan delivery.
